notes.title: Money or Meshikhah from a Gentile? Four Readings of the Broken-Vessels Baraita
notes.note: This chart has 5 columns of sentences, over the four-column limit in the chart rules. Rework it to four columns or fewer: put a party's several items of one kind in one cell as a numbered list, one per line, and put any replies in the same row as the arguments they answer, numbered to match. Keep the content and the row/column orientation. If every cell is really a word or two (a grid of cases against rulings that the colors make easy to read), leave it as it is and say so in skipped.
